class.name: OcgGeomDirection
class.brief_description: The class Direction specifies a vector that is never null. It is a unit vector.
class.description: ! The class Direction specifies a vector that is never null. ! It is a unit vector.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a unit vector with it 3 cartesian coordinates.

method.name: SetDir
method.description: Converts the gp_Dir unit vector V into this unit vector.

method.name: Dir
method.description: Returns the non transient direction with the same coordinates as <me>.

method.name: Magnitude
method.description: returns 1.0 which is the magnitude of any unit vector.

method.name: SquareMagnitude
method.description: returns 1.0 which is the square magnitude of any unit vector.

method.name: Cross
method.description: Computes the cross product between <me> and <Other>.

method.name: CrossCross
method.description: Computes the triple vector product <me> ^(V1 ^ V2).

method.name: Crossed
method.description: Computes the cross product between <me> and <Other>. A new direction is returned.

method.name: CrossCrossed
method.description: Computes the triple vector product <me> ^(V1 ^ V2).

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this unit vector, then normalizes it.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this unit vector.
